args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

pickLocale currently returns the first language tag in header order, ignoring the `;q=` quality value. It should parse the q value for each tag (defaulting to q=1 when absent) and select the supported locale with the highest weight.

args.title: Reject non-integer values in config int() parsing
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The int() helper uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10), which silently truncates trailing non-digit characters (e.g. "12h" becomes 12) instead of throwing. Update the parsing to validate that the raw string is a full integer (e.g. use a strict integer regex or check String(value) === raw) so malformed values like "12h" or "1h" throw at startup instead of being silently accepted.

args.title: Return non-200 status for degraded readiness checks
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The readiness handler maps status to HTTP code with `res.status(status === "down" ? 503 : 200).json(...)`, so a "degraded" status (e.g. checks.queue degraded) still returns HTTP 200, making it indistinguishable from "ok" for simple HTTP-status based probes. Change the mapping so "degraded" yields a non-200 (or otherwise distinguishable) response, or document the intended semantics for operators.
